resources.string: Automatically manage your phone sound mode based on your location.
Never worry about your phone ringing during lectures, exams, or library study hours again.
Automatically detects when you enter college blocks and switches to Silent or Vibrate mode seamlessly.
BlockSilent processes your location locally on your device to trigger geofences without sharing data externally.
When leaving a location, BlockSilent automatically restores your previous sound mode settings.
Optimized with native Android Geofencing APIs to ensure minimal battery usage and 100% data privacy.

The application uses location information only to detect whether the user has entered or exited configured college areas. Location data is processed locally on the device and is never shared with external servers.
